title: Demand for more stories set in the water

tellings.quote: he was saying in the second season you need to do more stuff in the water.

plain: In 1996, at the Los Angeles offices of the TV series Dark Skies, a man Bryce Zabel calls "the captain" told the writers that in the second season they needed to "do more stuff in the water." Zabel, who says he was there, tells this to Michels as part of a story about Hollywood and the government. If it was more than a passing note, it would mean someone was steering the show's UFO stories toward the sea.
